title: S05T02 - Implement OpenSpec import, link, status, and validation
description: Read OpenSpec proposals, designs, tasks, delta specs, and current specs; link them to Boreal containers and work; validate freshness without rewriting OpenSpec-owned artifacts unexpectedly.
acceptanceCriteria: A brownfield OpenSpec change imports with stable provenance and maps its tasks and scenarios to Boreal work and gates.
Status reports missing, changed, stale, or conflicting artifacts and provides non-destructive refresh commands.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
